reviews.text: Excellent place! The reception staff are wonderful and very attentive. It's a place where you can find all kinds of clothing, and they even have sizes for large dogs.

Excellent service
Very friendly
Plenty of staff to care for your puppy 🐕
Super gentle and loving with your pet!

It's a shame that this company's policies end up creating a bad experience for its customers.

In their dog grooming service, they don't guarantee your dog will be ready at a specific time, but they expect you to pick it up in less than 30 minutes after they call, or they charge a late fee. I find this policy unfair, designed more to generate additional charges than to provide good customer service.

Furthermore, one of the receptionists called me to explain this policy and ended up speaking rudely to me, even raising her voice. Regardless of the company's rules, no customer should be treated that way.

The company should improve both the transparency of its policies and the training of its customer service staff.

Unfortunately, experiences like this make you not want to use their services.
My dogs went into the bathroom at 11:30 am, and the staff forgot to tell me they were ready! They weren't returned to me until 2:20 pm, only because I went to check on them. TERRIBLE SERVICE
The quality of customer service has declined. I liked it better before.

They provide excellent service and care to both pets and owners. Their boarding service is very good, and you can keep an eye on your pet through the cameras, although honestly, it's not necessary because you trust the staff :) I highly recommend them

On Friday, I went to complete the vaccination package I purchased for Joy, and they administered the Canigen MHA-PPi vaccine.

On Saturday, she started feeling ill; she stopped eating and only drank water. She was worse on Sunday, and I took her back on Monday because she hadn't eaten and was extremely weak.
I thought it was also the heat, but it wasn't. It's a reaction to the vaccine that led to severe regenerative anemia, which isn't bacterial but a reaction to the vaccine. She's hospitalized, and a vaccine triggered this. Please don't give them to your pets. And this place where I took Joy for a bath, so happy, today I can't believe it. You don't have 24/7 service, which you should have in these situations. They also gave her a tablet, and I didn't know what they gave her, and I had to make an unexpected expense for Joy in these urgent situations. And today they casually told me to change hospitals because yesterday they didn't tell me if something happens at night to go to Hospital Mexico; we work together, and they can help her, especially at night.

I'm going to file a complaint with PROFECO (the Mexican consumer protection agency) because this situation is unacceptable, and it's not enough to say "I understand" when Joy, a dog who takes care of herself and is loved, is in the hospital.
